correctness.rationale: Exact complex-polynomial expansion gives \(G_3\) and curvature \(G_3″/a^2=4-t^2+vP(t)\). For \(t\le2\), a positive quartic sum-of-squares and convex interpolation certify positivity. For \(t>2\), the sign is governed by \(v\ge(t^2-4)/P(t)\); its unique maximum follows from the one-positive-root Descartes shift \(Q(t+2)\), checked with exact signs. Jensen and local strict concavity prove the if-and-only-if including equality. RK1 and RK2 curvatures are strictly positive. A rational witness has certified strict gain \(401/36000\). Standalone verifier replayed successfully; numerical grids are supplementary.

value.rationale: Exact sharp boundary for possible mean-preserving timestep randomization gains at the first RK Taylor order where this effect can occur. The mathematical variable is a natural numerical-stability diagnostic: squared linear amplification for one-step random time grids. Quantified witness and all-law strict Jensen rigidity on the opposite side clarify stochastic versus deterministic numerical damping. The result does not claim fixed-time integration accuracy, which is a different objective.
